title: Correct retained-ledger cap reads and remaining r45 native fixture failures
acceptance_criteria: Fresh full native suite passes every required test, including all three r45 failures and the prior authenticated moving-target, pickup, portrait and corpse-damage regressions.

Read-only damage previews return an existing authoritative ledger after medical death without importing a zero-health vanilla baseline; pressure applies a full ceiling-crossing hit, stops above the cap, and reopens after healing.

Idle-mouse fixtures establish actual entity-ticking readiness at their assertion clock without skipping independent-direction or destination-movement assertions; nonpullable controls verify their resolved policy instead of treating supported Villagers as unpullable.
Full JVM, affected readiness, isolated client startup and packaging pass; connected physical input, GPU quality and owner acceptance remain separate.
manual_steps: Throw a mouse horizontally and immediately Ctrl-left-click to pull. Compare pickup; repeat with critical/dead mice. Walls and out-of-reach targets must still deny.
Compare analyzer damage before/after a corpse falls; repeat on Mouse and Human/Pig. Check existing fire/blast exposure; the original body must stay Dead.
Check analyzer state/species/portraits and retained smooth camera, escape across hand transfers, real-drop interruption and cursor cleanup.
